items.q: Can I buy as an end customer or only distributors?
items.a: FREY operates B2B. For retail purchases we connect you with the nearest authorized master distributor (EMBLER in LATAM). We reply within 24 h with the correct channel.

items.q: What is the order minimum for new distributors?
items.a: No order minimum for active certified distributors. For initial onboarding we request a ,000 USD sample purchase to evaluate logistics and regional demand.

items.q: How do I verify a part is FREY original?
items.a: Each box ships with a serialized label you can audit against the lot-by-lot traceability database. If in doubt, send SKU photo + lot number and we validate within 4 business hours.

items.q: Do you work with commercial vehicle fleets?
items.a: Yes. We have a specific program for fleets (Sprinter, Vito, European commercial) with tiered volume pricing and scheduled lot-by-lot delivery.

items.q: Do you provide tech support for install or diagnosis?
items.a: Yes, the Embler team in CDMX provides bilingual ES/EN tech support for authorized distributors. For specific fitment, share VIN + symptom and you receive a documented recommendation.

items.q: Do you cover all generations of each model?
items.a: We cover the highest-volume generations in operation (last 15 years). For older vehicles or rare applications, contact us: we have an OEM and aftermarket search network for off-catalog parts.

items.q: How do I request distributor account opening?
items.a: Fill out the Contact form with subject «I want to become a distributor» or write directly to freymarketing@cnfrey.com. Validation takes 5–10 business days.

cta.title: Another question?
cta.subtitle: If your case is not above, write directly to our sales team and receive a documented reply within 24 business hours.
